text: Login SSO Flow - Audit Finding

Component 11:01 in Sprint 4 working file. MyHealthHub Portal demonstrates a persistent breadcrumb nav pattern during their authentication redirect flow. Users always know where they are in the SSO handoff, even across multiple identity provider screens.
Our current implementation drops all orientation cues when the user transitions through the SSO redirect. This is the primary usability gap for the login surface.
Severity set to high per Notion update. Scheduled for redesign in next sprint cycle.
Refill Flow Step Navigation - Audit Finding

Component 11:14. From P12 usability session at 00:14: "I keep losing my place when I switch between the medication list and the pickup options." This maps directly to the step navigation gap we identified in the refill flow.

CareNav Portal uses an inline refill tracker pattern that keeps the user oriented throughout the medication flow. Their sidebar tracker persists across all steps, preventing the exact disorientation P12 described.
High severity. Cross-referenced with competitor annotations and usability session recording. Evidence chain is strong.
Messaging Thread View - Audit Finding
Component 11:27. P12 noted uncertainty about message status and thread continuity during secure messaging interactions. Users do not know whether a message was sent, read, or requires follow-up.

WellSync Patient Portal uses contextual help tooltips in their messaging views as a reference pattern. Tooltips appear on hover and on first visit, providing orientation cues about thread state and available actions.
Medium severity. Pending further review before scheduling for redesign. Less critical than login and refill flow gaps but still impacts user confidence.

Pickup Confirmation Accessibility Gap

References component 12:88. Users mentioned similar navigation friction during pickup confirmation in earlier sessions. No persistent indicator for completion status. Needs frame verification before audit inclusion.
Login Flow - SSO Observation
Component 11:01. The persistent breadcrumb nav reference from MyHealthHub applies here as well. Users report losing their place during SSO redirects across multiple identity providers.
Token Library Quarterly Review
Added new neutral shade scale to the design system. Fourteen shades from gray-50 through gray-900 with WCAG AA contrast ratios verified against both light and dark backgrounds.
Onboarding Empty-State Copy
Revising empty-state copy across three onboarding screens. Current copy is too technical for first-time users.
Component Library Audit Q3
Chip variant audit for Q3. Reviewing spacing and color usage across 14 chip variants in the design system.
Form Validation Handling
Documenting validation patterns for inline field errors and summary banners. Need consensus on whether to use shake animation or red border highlight.
Loading State Interactions
Skeleton screens versus spinner decision log. Team consensus leans toward skeleton for content-heavy views and spinner for action confirmations.
Animation Timing Principles
Refreshing easing curves and duration guidelines. Targeting 200ms for micro-interactions and 350ms for page transitions.
